the copy runs in five VBE banks of 0x10000 bytes; the partial rows 0x40, 0x60, 0x80, 0x20, 0x20, 0x80, 0x60, and 0x40 dwords keep the streams contiguous, and the five calls to the bank switch at 0x8c0fc select the banks
the original has no EBP frame and uses no floating-point instruction, so the module builds without -of+ and links no FPU stub

the harness holds the 640 by 400 source buffer, the five bank captures, and the bank stub; the bank stub records the call order and captures the 64 KiB window, and the expected output follows the original row step and the piece widths; the output holds the markers 0, 1, and D; the behavior check passes

the rebuilt module holds 407 bytes and 143 decoded instructions; the identity check stays open at 17 of 143 instructions and 24 of 407 bytes because V2 pushes ecx, esi, edi, and ebp and reserves 8 stack bytes instead of cld, pushal, and popal, keeps the row step in a stack slot, uses div instead of idiv, and copies with a dword loop instead of rep movsd; the build and behavior checks pass, so the store records rebuilt
